evidence.description: Cómo combinar ID estables y un paquete de referencia al actualizar un mazo de Anki generado.
evidence.judgement: Current title/description identify the topic task and bounded outcome. Navigation uses consistent locale terms and recognizable destinations. English/Chinese values remain from main; migrated Spanish metadata was read as current locale maps.

Neutral technical Spanish uses nota, tarjeta and mazo distinctly, retains API literals and product names, and describes ownership as retained bytes/lifetime. Update wording preserves client-import limitations.

reviewMethod.independence: This reviewer did not author or integrate the candidate. The same agent previously performed its Spec review and reported issues; this subsequent independent source-language assessment is not a blind review or native-speaker attestation.
reviewMethod.scope: 34 topics × English, Simplified Chinese and Spanish. Full Spanish long-form prose, all three UI/framework catalogs, titles/descriptions, sidebar/navigation, language briefs/terminology, AI prompt templates/contracts, shared page components and source search vocabulary.
reviewMethod.method: Read current Spanish prose and localized/shared copy. Verify current English/Chinese prose and catalogs against independently reviewed main; adopt traceable previous assessments only for unchanged inputs. Reread all six changed Spanish documents and five descriptions after final integration edits. Hashes bind the judgement to exact bytes and are not a substitute for reviewing language.
reviewMethod.unchangedEnglishChinese: English/Chinese long-form source bodies and both catalogs are byte-identical to main. Retain prior independent judgements and all 32 minor observations. Current task introductions, catalogs, metadata, shared components and AI templates were read; this report does not claim a fresh line-by-line proofread of every unchanged English/Chinese body.
reviewMethod.exclusions: No generated HTML, browser behavior, SEO efficacy, live search quality, SDK execution, model-generated output or technical pass is claimed. Technical axes remain pending.
reviewMethod.scoring: Retain justified 4 scores for dense technical syntax, register or usability. Clear topic copy earns 5. Two newly introduced minor Spanish editorial observations remain explicit; there are no major/critical language issues.
